coverage.scope: Recursive scan of every Lua/Perl file in i-p zones; excludes support lua_modules/plugins. All files read for signal inventory; substantive candidate bodies and wiring inspected. No live/DB availability verification.

rows.title: Noble Oldencamp and the necromancer delegation
rows.reason: Bard pre-epic spawns a necromancer delegation and frost giant escort with timed cleanup.
rows.notes: Includes Amilia, Puella, Xeegarn and Locis as one event.

rows.title: Dire kodiak / forest dragon transformation
rows.reason: At its health threshold the dire kodiak becomes a forest dragon; combat exit controls persistence.
rows.notes: Bard 1.5.

rows.title: Cloaked figure / shadow thief
rows.reason: Hail starts malignant-shadow respawns; kill count reveals a shadow thief with an HP mechanic.
rows.notes: Bard 1.5.

rows.title: Blackened Treant and Blackened Dryad
rows.reason: Treant splits into limbs; clearing limbs summons a Dryad with timed Withering Glare.

rows.title: Vorash, Deep and Xenevorash
rows.reason: Triggered opponents and death signals coordinate the final monk-epic boss activation.

rows.title: Scorpion hatchling ambush
rows.reason: Quest-qualified death trigger spawns a large scorpion ring.
rows.notes: Unusual trigger name needs an NPC identity check before a player-facing title is chosen.

rows.title: Man-eating Freshwater Shark
rows.reason: Necromancer pre-epic shark has successive HP stages.

rows.title: Kazen Fecae undead trial
rows.reason: Quest-started bone golem death continues a chain of undead opponents.
rows.notes: Necromancer 1.0.

rows.title: High Priestess Shima ambush
rows.reason: Quest dialogue or turn-in creates Shima and five priests/priestesses at the fight location.
rows.notes: Cleric pre-1.5. Short event without extensive phase logic.

rows.title: Taskmaster Mirot and the reanimated minions
rows.reason: Wayfarer scene becomes hostile Mirot plus six minions with linked aggro and range checks.
rows.notes: Cleric 1.5.

rows.title: Ritual Conduit
rows.reason: Conduit/Reborn setup leads to HP-triggered Juggernauts and timed encounter limits.
rows.notes: Druid 1.5.

rows.title: Spiritbinder Trenzar and Senvial of the Mist
rows.reason: Timed elemental adds and flame waves combine with Senvial HP and state changes.
rows.notes: Ranger 1.5.

rows.title: Vesthon Marijakin: first confrontation
rows.reason: Hsagra turn-in spawns Vesthon and guards; a timed scene and HP escape control the encounter.
rows.notes: Bard 1.5.

rows.title: Vesthon Marijakin and the Dracoliche of Hsagra
rows.reason: Masters and respawning minions gate Vesthon; his defeat activates a dracoliche finale.
rows.notes: Bard 1.5 second fight.

rows.title: Dire griffon / plains dragon transformation
rows.reason: Dire griffon becomes a plains dragon at its scripted HP trigger.
rows.notes: Bard 1.5.

rows.title: Remal the Black
rows.reason: Keelee starts repeating orc waves and banishment checks before the final Remal fight.
rows.notes: Paladin 2.0.

rows.title: Lightning Warrior Spiritseeker
rows.reason: Quest proximity spawns Spiritseeker; combat summons two spiritsappers and a cleanup timer.
rows.notes: Shaman 2.0.

rows.title: General Bragmur escort (Coldain shawl finale)
rows.reason: Waypoint-driven escort has repeated wolf and giant ambushes, commanders and a final ritual.
rows.notes: Escort uses numeric NPC script 110227; database grid must be checked for detailed guide.

rows.title: Rakshasa skull ritual
rows.reason: Courier and ritual signals trigger an eight-spawn undead ambush.
rows.notes: Optional short quest-event guide.

rows.title: Glowing cliff golem and Watch Sergeant Grolj
rows.reason: Granika creates a golem encounter and a coordinated undead guard group.
rows.notes: Greenmist final quest; little phase logic.

rows.title: Chambers of Singular Might
rows.reason: Named trial completion and instance-specific access are present.
rows.notes: Combat details are thin in Lua; confirm database abilities before a detailed guide.

rows.title: Chambers of Twin Struggles
rows.reason: Malevolent priests and constrained servitors have linked progression and combat scripts.
rows.notes: Duplicate NPC-name variants consolidated; numeric version not inferred.

rows.title: Chambers of the Tri-Fates
rows.reason: Flesh hunters and a trigger coordinate kill success, failure and trial progression.

rows.title: Chambers of Righteousness
rows.reason: Priest/custodian HP phases, defender/guardian progression and door gates form a raid sequence.
rows.notes: Can be one guide with separate boss sections.

rows.title: Chambers of Glorification
rows.reason: Visionaries change at HP stages; guardian stages split while supporting kills weaken their stats.

rows.title: Chambers of Transcendence
rows.reason: Acolyte HP stages and class-related final blows lead to Guardian and Vrex progression.

rows.title: Chambers of Destruction / Keeper of the Altar
rows.reason: Altar progression, class-specific adherents, sentry HP stages and Keeper timers define the raid.
rows.notes: Keeper and altar helpers are consolidated under the trial.

rows.title: Kelekdrix, Herald of Trushar
rows.reason: Boss activation and add deaths coordinate with reset and timer behavior.
rows.notes: Part of Inktuta; includes watchers/ushers.

rows.title: The Exiles / Stonemite trial
rows.reason: Four exiles require coordinated phrases in a timed window with explicit success/failure.
rows.notes: Part of Inktuta.

rows.title: The Cursecallers
rows.reason: Noqufiel summons six cursecallers; a trigger spawns pursuit cursebearers and detects completion.
rows.notes: Consolidates six callers and pursuit helpers.

rows.title: Noqufiel: true and mirror images
rows.reason: Coordinated images swap/reveal through HP events, combat timers and final death transition.

rows.title: Mimezpo the Oracle
rows.reason: Named spawns a guard group and has a raid death transition.
rows.notes: Limited combat logic in Lua; inspect database abilities before a detailed guide.

rows.title: Pixtt Grand Summoner ring
rows.reason: Priest deaths activate the summoner and golem stages, with combat/leash/timer handlers.

rows.title: Temple of the Damned
rows.reason: Destroying remains triggers ambushers and Dire Summoner activation through kill signals.

rows.title: Ritesmaster Verok
rows.reason: Locks room doors and spawns/activates eggs at HP thresholds with leash/reset behavior.

rows.title: The Council of Nine
rows.reason: Avatar changes form/stats by HP stage and has combat timers.
rows.notes: Version selected by instance_version constant; no literal version asserted.

rows.title: Find Fibblebrap 4: The Korlach
rows.reason: Open-world cocoon rescue and instance scaling, death progress and exit hooks are present.
rows.notes: Instance script has TODO Create NPC for Bilitan (349999); verify completeness.

rows.title: Deserting the Ranks
rows.reason: Triggered second phase, Draygun movement/timers and captain death advance the mission.
rows.notes: Normal/hard task identifiers declared; runtime version uses a named constant.

rows.title: Emperor Draygun, the Lich King
rows.reason: HP-driven forms, soul adds and cast-on-target handling implement a healing/damage phase.

rows.title: King Tormax
rows.reason: Combat timer recruits surviving named guards into the fight.
rows.notes: Normal encounter, distinct from Fabled variant.

rows.title: Statue, Idol and Avatar of War
rows.reason: Statue death spawns Idol, followed by Avatar with timed presence and cycle state.
rows.notes: One three-stage raid sequence.

rows.title: Kael armor / plate cycle
rows.reason: Proximity phrase starts Doldigun and successive giant waves.
rows.notes: Named giant helpers consolidated.

rows.title: Fabled King Tormax
rows.reason: Fabled controller registers Tormax combat, guard assistance, timers and death behavior.
rows.notes: Do not assume this equals central seasonal registry version.

rows.title: Fabled Statue, Idol and Avatar of War
rows.reason: Fabled three-boss sequence has death transitions, timers and expedition lockouts.

rows.title: Tissa, Sovereign of Terror and the nine lives of Kerra
rows.reason: Eight generals weaken Tissa when killed; full-power Tissa offers a bonus reward.
rows.notes: Requires GM-Kerra content flag and nonzero instance. Includes Ahed split, Dou linked kittens, Siete physical resistance, Ath healer final blow, Tin, Ano, Piat, Exi. Generals can become separate entries.

rows.title: Tybone Biggums
rows.reason: Boss changes golem/mastruq/skeleton forms with untargetable add intermissions.
rows.notes: Gathering Event 2022; current availability requires content-gate confirmation.

rows.title: Frozen Nightmare: Frostfoot goblins
rows.reason: Scout escape spawns Raid Leader Sig Chol and Taskmaster Suttalp, who summon ongoing henchmen.
rows.notes: Raider module is shared trash behavior.

rows.title: Frozen Nightmare: sundering sludge
rows.reason: Sundering sludge splits into severing then slippery sludges; completion signals the raid controller.

rows.title: Frozen Nightmare: chromatic bonewalkers
rows.reason: Bonewalkers cycle through colored forms with a coordinated icy-form completion condition.

rows.title: Frozen Nightmare: Sharalla
rows.reason: Defend Sharalla's corpse from animals; accumulated bites trigger failure.

rows.title: Frozen Nightmare: Marrow the Broken
rows.reason: Successive HP thresholds shrink the golem and create splinterbone skeleton adds.
rows.notes: Script notes missing splinterbone dervish alternative in the database.

rows.title: Frozen Nightmare: Laskuth the Colossus
rows.reason: Durgin unlocks the finale after prior events, spawning Laskuth and sleet flurries.
rows.notes: Six subevents may instead be one Frozen Nightmare raid document.

rows.title: Struggles within the Progeny / Valdoon Kel'Novar
rows.reason: Real/fake Valdoon, guardian deaths, lookout adds, powerdown windows and raid completion are scripted.

rows.title: Bristlebane the King of Thieves (2.0)
rows.reason: HP stages summon changing jester groups and update boss phases with reset handling.
rows.notes: 2.0 is script encounter label, not an asserted instance version.

rows.title: The Luggald Broodmother
rows.reason: Waypoint sequence escalates defender/archseeker waves before spawning the combat Broodmother.

rows.title: Cragbeast Queen (seasonal)
rows.reason: Seasonal boss has periodic abilities and recruits nearby NPCs into combat.
rows.notes: Version 200 checked explicitly; deduplicate central seasonal registry.

rows.title: Zlandicar (seasonal)
rows.reason: Telegraphed incision, septic and lobotomy mechanics plus operating-table and burn phases are implemented.
rows.notes: Deduplicate central seasonal registry; native variant differs.

rows.title: Lady Vox (seasonal)
rows.reason: Seasonal branch adds successive HP abilities and add waves with reset/leash handling.
rows.notes: Version 200 checked explicitly; deduplicate central registry.

rows.title: Ba'Zrath, the Bound Lich
rows.reason: Proposed weakness/challenge boss exists as an encounter file.
rows.notes: No loader/registration found; placeholder NPC IDs and undefined npc references. Not ready for player guide.

rows.title: Chess event
rows.reason: Chess wave design and partial registration skeleton exist.
rows.notes: Empty mob lists, TODO king and loot, no current loader found.

rows.title: Turkey Zek the Gobble Lord
rows.reason: Holiday raid design and partial directional attacks, collection barrier and HP handlers exist.
rows.notes: NPC IDs all placeholder 123456, reward TBD and loader not established.

rows.title: Terris Thule
rows.reason: HP-triggered defiler waves, dream disruption and gargoyle activation combine with a lair leash.

rows.title: Chamberlain Escalardian
rows.reason: Castellan/constable kills unlock Chamberlain, whose combat uses timed memblur.

rows.title: Stormrider island
rows.reason: Clearing stormriders starts successive add/priest stages and island completion.

rows.title: Elemental Masterpiece
rows.reason: Trash kills activate four elemental champions followed by the masterpiece.

rows.title: Melernil Faal'Armanna
rows.reason: Phoenix island clear leads through firesurger/windsurger stages to the boss.

rows.title: Sigismond Windwalker
rows.reason: Spider kills progress the event, activating archwalker and timed adds.

rows.title: Xegony, Queen of Air
rows.reason: Dedicated controller coordinates the boss, waves of adds and resets.

rows.title: Dust ring / Perfected Warder of Earth
rows.reason: Devotees and Triumvirate of Soil progression unlock the Warder.

rows.title: Mud ring / Monstrous Mudwalker
rows.reason: Sludge lurker HP stages produce add waves before the final mudwalker.

rows.title: Stone ring / Peregrin Rockskull
rows.reason: Multiple stone types, waves and counters drive a staged ring event.

rows.title: Vine ring / Derugoak Bloodwalker
rows.reason: Tainted-beast deaths create vegerogs; clearing them activates the boss.

rows.title: Mystical Arbitor of Earth
rows.reason: Ring completion leads to Arbitor, with timed memblur and final progression.
rows.notes: Old arbitor controller is commented out; zone_status now owns progression.

rows.title: Warlord Gintolaken
rows.reason: Three clan/chieftain kill chains unlock Warlord with failure/reset timers.

rows.title: Rathe Council and Avatar of Earth
rows.reason: Mezzable/non-mezzable council handling, HP-based damage, death timing and Avatar finale.

rows.title: Fennin Ro, Tyrant of Fire
rows.reason: Four explicit phases progress from trash to bridge, council and Fennin.

rows.title: Manaetic Behemoth
rows.reason: Bomb/device control activates the targetable boss with leash, failure and success signals.

rows.title: Nitram Anizok / Xanamech Nezmirthafen
rows.reason: Quest event replaces fake dragon with the real combat NPC and monitors win/fail timers.

rows.title: Trial of Execution
rows.reason: Protect a prisoner through waves before Prime Executioner Vathoch.

rows.title: Trial of Flame
rows.reason: Timed flame waves and AE punishment lead to Punisher of Flame.

rows.title: Trial of Hanging
rows.reason: Protect prisoners from suffocation spirits before Gallows Master Teion.

rows.title: Trial of Lashing
rows.reason: Manage prisoners/spirits and waves before Lashman Azakal.

rows.title: Trial of Stoning
rows.reason: Incoming waves and prisoner defense culminate in Yurae Zhaleem.

rows.title: Trial of Torture
rows.reason: Tormentor waves, healing wraith and failure checks lead to Punisher Veshtaq.

rows.title: The Seventh Hammer
rows.reason: Timed Tribunal signals cast Verdict of Eternity or Tremor of Judgment.
rows.notes: Distinct from monk epic NPC sharing its name.

rows.title: Mujaki the Devourer
rows.reason: Servant waves, guardian checks and timers control Mujaki activation.

rows.title: Deyid the Twisted
rows.reason: Trees spawn, close in at successive HP stages and become hostile adds.

rows.title: Terror Matriarch
rows.reason: HP trigger starts repeating hatchling spawns during combat.

rows.title: Aid Eino escort / Dreamkeeper
rows.reason: Waypoint ambushes attack Eino; Dreamkeeper death finishes the event.

rows.title: Drornok Tok Vo'Lok
rows.reason: Clearing pond enemies triggers Drornok; his HP thresholds spawn more adds.

rows.title: Ston'Ruak, Ancient of Trees
rows.reason: Tree clears trigger extra waves then the Ancient, with reset signals.

rows.title: Falto, Lord of Thunder
rows.reason: Area clears and mephit progression summon Falto; controller supports reset.

rows.title: Tallon Zek
rows.reason: Combat timers execute targeted attacks and aggro bouncing with completion flagging.

rows.title: Vallon Zek
rows.reason: HP-triggered splits/waves and a dedicated controller govern progression.

rows.title: Rallos Zek the Warlord
rows.reason: Three stages cover Tallon/Vallon, fake Rallos and the Warlord with pit adds.

rows.title: Maareq the Prophet
rows.reason: HP combat changes and recurring minions lead into Tylis/Keeper progression.

rows.title: Keeper of Sorrows / Tylis' torment
rows.reason: Tylis activates a sequence ending in Keeper, whose death frees Tylis.
rows.notes: Associated chamber NPC wiring needs review before a full guide.

rows.title: Salczek the Fleshgrinder
rows.reason: Combat changes at 40 and 20 percent with reset handling.

rows.title: Saryrn
rows.reason: Ravens appear at successive HP thresholds; Sorrowsong activates late in combat.

rows.title: Baraguj Szuul mouth event
rows.reason: Mouth trigger populates a multi-level gauntlet and final Baraguj state.
rows.notes: Legacy Perl trigger coexists with Lua NPCs; entry/completion wiring needs review.

rows.title: Aerin'Dar
rows.reason: HP stages activate golem adds and reset them when the boss recovers.

rows.title: Coirnav, Avatar of Water
rows.reason: Timed waves and intermediate bosses activate final Coirnav stage.

rows.title: Plane of Time: phases 1-3
rows.reason: Elemental trial triggers, phase-two waves and phase-three progression are scripted.
rows.notes: Early trials can be sections of one guide.

rows.title: Plane of Time: phase 4 gods
rows.reason: Terris/Saryrn summon threshold adds, Vallon splits and Tallon has tether/kill progression.
rows.notes: May split into four god entries after approval.

rows.title: Plane of Time: phase 5 gods
rows.reason: Bertoxxulous stats escalate, Innoruuk summons adds, Rallos gains rampage/flurry, Cazic completes the quartet.
rows.notes: May split into four god entries after approval.

rows.title: Quarm
rows.reason: Losing heads changes AE sets; repeating adds and reset/finale progression are scripted.

rows.title: The Archivist's Midnight Vigil
rows.reason: Group expedition hunts respawning castle enemies, tracks verified kills and awards four relics needed to request the raid.
rows.notes: Version 11 explicitly configured, group size 3-6 and level 50 minimum. New mission document distinct from the five existing version-10 raid boss journals.

rows.title: Vampyre Troubles: Autarkic Lord Sfarosh
rows.reason: Dialogue ritual and allies culminate in hostile Sfarosh and three shade adds with a time limit.
rows.notes: Can include imprisoned shade as the earlier quest battle.

rows.title: Garzicor's Corpse and Wraith
rows.reason: Blood offering starts a corpse fight; its defeat spawns the final dragon wraith, followed by the reward shade.
rows.notes: Consolidates ritual and two combat forms.

rows.title: Gravekeeper Vhal
rows.reason: Existing journal derived from current Mistmoore Eclipse scripts.
rows.notes: Already documented: gravekeeper-vhal

rows.title: Castellan Veyr
rows.reason: Existing journal derived from current Mistmoore Eclipse scripts.
rows.notes: Already documented: castellan-veyr

rows.reason: Existing journal derived from current Mistmoore Eclipse scripts.
rows.notes: Already documented: huntmaster-draeven

rows.reason: Existing journal derived from current Mistmoore Eclipse scripts.

rows.reason: Existing journal derived from current Mistmoore Eclipse scripts.
rows.notes: Already documented: last-eclipse-finale
